searchText: For proto-danksharding, this is not a concern at all For full danksharding, yes, either block producing nodes have to be specialized, or we need distributed block builders I'm looking for estimates in bandwidth increase with 4844, are there some available? I see that the blob is targeted at 1MB per slot, but it's not clear to me about how many times it will have to be uploaded to peers. Assuming just one download and two uploads per slot it adds 2Mbps of bandwidth to validators
